readme:
# Jobweb Ghana Jobs Scraper Scrape job listings from Jobweb Ghana ([jobwebghana.com](https://jobwebghana.com/)), a Ghanaian job board. You get the title, company, job type, location, posting date and the start of the posting text for every job, and with job page details the deadline, category, area, salary text, qualifications, how to apply and the full description. Search by keyword, category, location or job type. ## What you get - One row per job, with a clean ISO date. - Optional job page details: exact posting time, closing date, category, area, salary text when the posting states one, qualifications, how to apply and the full description as HTML and plain text. - E-mail addresses that a posting publishes in its how-to-apply text, exactly as found. - Each job once per run, even when several keywords find it. - A run with no input returns the newest 5 jobs. ## Use with AI Agents (MCP) Connect this actor to any MCP-compatible AI client: Claude Desktop, Claude.ai, Cursor, VS Code, LangChain, LlamaIndex, or custom agents. **Apify MCP server URL:** `https://mcp.apify.com?tools=santamaria-automations/jobwebghana-jobs-scraper` **Example prompt once connected:** > "Use `jobwebghana-jobs-scraper` to find up to 5 jobs for the keyword "accountant" (accountant roles in Accra). Return results as a table with title, company, location and job URL." Clients that support dynamic tool discovery (Claude.ai, VS Code) receive the full input schema automatically. ## Input Every field is optional. Example: ```json { "maxResults": 5 } ``` | Field | What it does | |---|---| | `searchQueries` | Keywords such as accountant or driver. Each keyword is its own search. | | `categories` | Job categories such as banking-jobs-in-ghana or it-telecom-jobs-in-ghana. Short names such as Banking work too. Each category is read as its own list. | | `locations` | Places such as jobs-in-accra, kumasi, tema or east-legon. Each location is read as its own list. | | `jobTypes` | full-time, part-time, freelance, internship or temporary. | | `maxResultsPerQuery` | Jobs per keyword, category or location. Default 50, up to 1000. | | `maxResults` | Jobs in total. Default 200. 0 means no limit. | | `includeDetails` | Read each job page for the extra fields. Default false. | With keywords and a category or location together, the keywords filter the title and the start of the text of that list. A category, location or job type that does not exist gives no rows. ## Sample output ```json { "id": "public-relations-officer-happy-sunshine-co-ltd", "post_id": 24496, "title": "Public Relations Officer", "title_full": "Public Relations Officer at Happy Sunshine Co., Ltd", "company": "Happy Sunshine Co., Ltd", "job_type": "Full-Time", "job_type_slug": "full-time", "featured": true, "snippet": "JOB VACANCY: PUBLIC RELATIONS OFFICER (PR OFFICER) Department: Marketing Department ...", "location": "Ghana", "region": "Jobs in Accra", "region_slug": "jobs-in-accra", "category": "Administrative/Secretarial Jobs in Ghana", "category_slug": "administrativesecretarial-jobs-in-ghana", "categories": [ "Administrative/Secretarial Jobs in Ghana" ], "posted_text": "10/Nov/2026", "date_posted": "2026-11-10T09:36:17Z", "valid_through": "2026-11-28T00:00:00Z", "deadline": "2026-12-02", "deadline_text": "02 December, 2026", "employment_type": "FULL_TIME", "address_street": "ACCRA", "address_city": "ACCRA", "address_postal_code": "2233", "address_region": "GREATER ACCRA", "address_country": "GH", "salary_text": "GHC 6,000 - GHC 8,000", "industry": "FMCG - Food Manufacturing", "qualifications": "- Bachelor's degree in Public Relations, Communications, Journalism, Marketing, or a related field.\n- Minimum 2-4 years of relevant PR or corporate communications experience.", "how_to_apply_text": "Submit your CV to [removed]\n\nState the position you are applying for as the subject of your email", "apply_emails": [ "[removed]" ], "description_html": "

JOB VACANCY: PUBLIC RELATIONS OFFICER (PR OFFICER)

\n

Department: Marketing Department

", "description_text": "JOB VACANCY: PUBLIC RELATIONS OFFICER (PR OFFICER)\n\nDepartment: Marketing Department", "job_url": "https://jobwebghana.com/jobs/public-relations-officer-happy-sunshine-co-ltd/", "details_fetched": true, "search_query": "all jobs", "source": "jobwebghana.com", "scraped_at": "2026-11-10T12:00:00Z" } ``` ## Fields | Field | Type | Description | |---|---|---| | `id` | string | Slug of the job address (/jobs//). It is the dedup key. | | `post_id` | integer, null | Numeric post id of the job on the site. Only with job page details. | | `title` | string | Role part of the heading, without the company. | | `title_full` | string | Heading as the site shows it: role at company. | | `company` | string, null | Hiring company: the part of the heading after the last ' at ', or the company line of the job page. | | `job_type` | string, null | Job type label. | | `job_type_slug` | string, null | Job type as used by the site filter: freelance, full-time, internship, part-time or temporary. | | `featured` | boolean | true when the listing carries the featured style. | | `snippet` | string, null | Start of the posting text as shown on the list page. | | `location` | string, null | Location line of the listing (often just Ghana). | | `region` | string, null | State or area link of the job page. Only with job page details. | | `region_slug` | string, null | Slug of the area (/job-location//). Only with job page details. | | `category` | string, null | First job category of the job page. Only with job page details. | | `category_slug` | string, null | Slug of the first category (/job-category//). Only with job page details. | | `categories` | array | All job categories of the job page. Empty without job page details. | | `posted_text` | string, null | Posting date as written on the list page. | | `date_posted` | string, null | Posting date, ISO 8601 (UTC). The list page gives the day, the job page the time too. | | `valid_through` | string, null | Expiry of the posting as set by the site, ISO 8601, from the job page data. Only with job page details. | | `deadline` | string, null | Closing date as an ISO date, read from the Closing Date line of the posting; falls back to the date of `valid_through` when the text has none. Only with job page details. | | `deadline_text` | string, null | The closing date as written in the posting. Null when the posting has no Closing Date line. | | `employment_type` | string, null | Employment type of the job page data, for example FULL_TIME. Only with job page details. | | `address_street` | string, null | Street of the job location in the job page data. | | `address_city` | string, null | City of the job location in the job page data. | | `address_postal_code` | string, null | Postal code of the job location in the job page data. | | `address_region` | string, null | Region of the job location in the job page data. | | `address_country` | string, null | Country code of the job location in the job page data. | | `salary_text` | string, null | Salary line of the posting text (Salary Range or Salary), only when the posting writes one. Only with job page details. | | `industry` | string, null | Industry line of the posting text, only when the posting writes one. Only with job page details. | | `qualifications` | string, null | Qualifications or requirements section of the posting text. Only with job page details. | | `how_to_apply_text` | string, null | Text of the how-to-apply part of the posting, as published (may include a public e-mail address). Only with job page details. | | `apply_emails` | array | E-mail addresses published in the how-to-apply text. Empty when none. | | `description_html` | string, null | Posting text as HTML. Only with job page details. | | `description_text` | string, null | Posting text as plain text. Only with job page details. | | `job_url` | string | Address of the job page. | | `details_fetched` | boolean | true when the job page was read for this row. | | `search_query` | string | The keyword, category, location or 'all jobs' that found the row. | | `source` | string | Site host. | | `scraped_at` | string | When the row was scraped, ISO 8601 UTC. | Fields that a job does not show are `null` (lists are empty). Fields marked as coming from the job page are `null` when `includeDetails` is off. The list shows 10 jobs per page. ## Pricing This Actor uses pay per event. There is a small `apify-actor-start` event when a run starts and one `job-result` event for each job in the dataset. You are never charged for a job twice, and a run stops when it reaches the maximum charge you set. Price: $0.001 start fee per run, then $0.0009 per job result ($0.90 per 1,000 jobs). **New to Apify?** Every account gets a $5 free monthly platform credit, enough to try this actor at no cost. ## Related Actors - [Indeed Jobs Scraper - 60+ Countries, $0.06 per 1,000 Jobs](https://apify.com/santamaria-automations/indeed-http-scraper): Indeed jobs in over 60 countries. - [Jobrapido Scraper - Multi-Country Job Aggregator](https://apify.com/santamaria-automations/jobrapido-scraper): Jobs from the Jobrapido aggregator in many countries. - [Glassdoor Jobs Scraper - Salaries, Ratings, 20+ Countries](https://apify.com/santamaria-automations/glassdoor-scraper): Jobs, salaries and ratings from Glassdoor. ## FAQ **Which filters can I combine?** Keywords, categories and locations multiply: every pair runs as its own search. Job types apply to all of them. **Why do some jobs have no salary?** Most postings do not state a salary. When one does, `salary_text` holds the line from the posting. The site also puts the same default pay range in the page data of every job, so that range is not a real salary and is not returned. **Is the posting time exact?** With `includeDetails` on, yes: it comes from the job page. With it off, the list shows the day only, so the time is midnight UTC. **What happens when a keyword finds nothing?** The run ends normally with the status "0 jobs found for ." and nothing is charged. ## Support Something broken, or a field you wish this Actor returned? Open a ticket on the Actor's [Issues tab](https://apify.com/santamaria-automations/jobwebghana-jobs-scraper/issues) or email contact@nanoscrape.com. We usually respond within one working day.
